premises.text: Home automation adoption is very low because setup is frustrating despite customer excitement
premises.evidence_span: the adoption rate is an abysmal 2%

premises.text: Wired smart switches need costly electrician installs and cannot be used in many apartments; smart bulbs require multiple bulbs and disable the wall switch
premises.evidence_span: if you don't want to do it yourself, you can hire an electrician, but it'll cost you thousands of dollars

premises.text: Switchmate snaps magnetically onto standard switch screws and mechanically flips the switch, controllable from a phone
premises.evidence_span: It uses two magnets on the back that snap right to the screws on your standard light switch

premises.text: Same device enables vacation timers, approach detection, and manual-or-phone control without losing the wall switch
premises.evidence_span: you can still access your light switch manually or just turn it off right from your phone

premises.text: Go-to-market via crowdfunding pre-order, manufacturing partner, online retail, then brick-and-mortar
premises.evidence_span: Next month in February, we're planning to launch a pre-order campaign

value.text: Users get extremely simple smart lighting without painful install
value.evidence_span: makes smart lighting extremely simple without dealing with any of these issues

secondary_value.text: Mission to make the smart home simple more broadly
secondary_value.evidence_span: on a mission to make the smart home simple

causal_links.evidence_span: we will never compromise on making sure we make products that are extremely simple to use

notes: Use cases treated as applications of one mechanism (§4.1(2)). Optional hub and future vents/breakers folded as roadmap vision (§4.1(4)/(5)), not separate premises. Beta tester story is illustrative evidence.
